scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.dev: pnpm exec concurrently -n api,mobile -c blue,magenta "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:mobile"
scripts.dev:api: node scripts/sync-mobile-env.mjs && node scripts/print-lan-api-url.mjs && node scripts/start-api-dev.mjs
scripts.kill:api: sh -c 'lsof -ti :${PORT:-3000} | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo Freed port ${PORT:-3000}'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
